title: Chuyên đề thực tế - Kinh doanh quốc tế

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge and skills to analyze and solve real-world problems in international business operations.
Utilize appropriate methods and techniques to collect, analyze data, and solve problems in international business operations.
Demonstrate independent thinking and responsibility in planning, analyzing, evaluating, and proposing solutions to problems in international business operations.
Collect, process, and analyze data to identify issues related to international business operations.
Analyze and evaluate solutions to problems arising in international business operations.
Participate actively in group discussions and collaborative projects.
Effectively communicate findings and solutions in written and oral formats.
Manage and complete research projects and assignments within specified deadlines.
